entries.80d309fd576dd53b: As its management philosophy, the company sets out that it aims to be a company trusted by stakeholders, contributing to the development of society through logistics and continuing to take on challenges to become something different from what it is now, and it places "challenge," "trust," and "environment" as its management policies. Under the 1st Medium-Term Management Plan "Try2034," starting in fiscal 2024, the company states that, in order to fulfill its mission of sustaining social infrastructure, it will work to stabilize its management base, actively invest in human resource development, strengthen competitiveness, and expand its business domains, aiming for sustainable growth and enhancement of corporate value. The company also positions safety as the foundation of management, and states that it will work on thorough safe operation and safe work and improvement of transportation quality through strengthening of the safety management structure and continuous driver education.
